subject: Beta, Maintenance & a Huge Milestone for OnYourSite! 🚀
body:
A quick update & something to celebrate!

Hey {full_name},

We are currently in our Beta phase and are running some important maintenance work to optimize everything for you. But we also have some fantastic news that we just have to share!

🎉 Our new user backend is here!

We managed to develop a small but mighty new user backend. Sure, something like this probably exists out there somewhere already—but for us, this is an absolute mega success! It means we are making huge strides right now in improving OnYourSite for everyone.


Once the maintenance is complete, you can log back in and check out our progress for yourself. Thank you for being on this journey with us!
